status: PR-01 architecture baseline pending user review; not applied migrations
database: PostgreSQL 17 target; patch/driver lock and actual validation in PR-02
runtime: Python 3.12 target; independent Web dependency environment
id_strategy: UUIDv4; no semantic IDs or course-name keys
money: PostgreSQL bigint micro-CNY; JSON decimal integer string; 1 CNY = 1000000 micro-CNY
time: timestamptz UTC; Beijing quota calendar; sample indexes bigint, half-open ranges
common_rules: JSONB fields require versioned schemas and explicit size limits in service; not an unbounded catch-all
Every private FK includes owner_id; same-class/document lineage checks are additional deferred constraint triggers or transaction assertions where noted
No automatic cascade deleting learning trees; access tombstone then durable deletion workflow
Private read operations always apply owner+active-account+tombstone checks; RLS is defense in depth
All nullable FK pairs use PostgreSQL MATCH SIMPLE; common owner_id remains not-null
References forming pointer cycles use DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED; publication validates final membership in one transaction
Architecture schema includes later PR tables; create in dependency migrations as required, not all services upfront
